## Goal
Make docs text batch JSON parse failures throw a file-specific error containing a response preview capped at 200 characters while preserving fail-fast behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Malformed batch response errors include the file name.
- Malformed batch response errors include no more than 200 response characters.
- The existing DocsTextCommand non-zero failure path is preserved.

## Implementation Notes
Modify src/docs/commands/text.js around parseBatchJsonResponse/processTemplateFileBatch error construction; do not add fallback content application.

## Test Strategy
